newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse EBITDA $149 mln vs $53 mln.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse EBITDA $149 mln vs $53 mln.

text.p: Westinghouse's broadcasting group on Monday reported earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) of $149 million in its third quarter, compared with $53 million in the year-ago quarter.
The company also reported third quarter sales of $910 million compared with $166 million in the year-ago period.
Excluding the benefit from purchase price accounting, EBITDA for the broacast group fell 12 percent from last year, the company said.
The company said its radio stations continue to far exceed expectations, both in revenue growth and profitability.
The company said it expects to build on this performance as it looks forward to its merger with Infinity Broadcasting Corp.
